name: nsemlengine
description: NSEMLENGINE - next-day OHLCV forecasts (DeepLOB adapted to daily data): dataset, walk-forward, baselines, deeplob model

parts.name: code
parts.why: Package, tests, configuration and setup script.

parts.name: results
parts.why: Walk-forward results (metrics, summaries, predictions, trained deeplob models).

parts.name: dataset
parts.why: work\dataset_v2.parquet - rebuilt in about a minute with 'python -m nseml build'.

parts.name: live_models
parts.why: Trained nightly models (work\live\**) and the forecasts so far (work\predictions\**). Optional: models are retrained automatically when missing.

steps.name: environment variables + Python 3.12 .venv with PyTorch ROCm for the Radeon GPU (NSEMLENGINE_PYTHON)
rebuild the dataset if it was not moved
steps.run: if not exist work\dataset_v2.parquet {python} -m nseml build

steps.name: scheduled tasks NSEDATAENGINE-AtClose (14:57) + NSEMLENGINE-PredictClose (15:31): at-close forecast, asks for your Windows password
scheduled task NSEMLENGINE-PredictAlt (20:40, ALT model with delivery / short selling / MTF inputs; asks for your Windows password)
scheduled tasks NSEMLENGINE-PredictCloseAlt (15:33) + NSEMLENGINE-PredictAltClose (21:20): ALT-CLOSE model with the delivery nowcast; asks for your Windows password
scheduled tasks for the ALT-LINK model (NSEMLENGINE-Predict-alt_link 22:00, NSEMLENGINE-PredictClose-alt_link 15:35); asks for your Windows password

notes: Run commands with nseml.cmd (uses the GPU venv when setup ran with -Gpu), e.g. nseml.cmd predict
Nightly forecasts: work\predictions\latest.csv after the 20:00 task; first run trains the models (about 20-30 min on a CPU).
